in_hebrew.name: Backer
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Backer הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek word 'hupokateos', meaning 'one who lies under, one who helps, one who supports'. This name was given to individuals who would help others in times of need.
